requirements.title: Count lines, words and characters
requirements.description: `python -m textcli count <path>` reads the UTF-8 file and prints 'lines words chars' separated by single spaces on one stdout line, exit code 0. Lines: number of newline-terminated lines, plus one for a final line without a trailing newline. Words: whitespace-separated tokens (str.split). Chars: number of Unicode characters including newline characters (no newline translation).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A file containing 'hello world\nfoo\n' prints '2 3 16' and exits 0
A file 'a b\nc' (no trailing newline) prints '2 3 5' and exits 0
A Korean UTF-8 file '안녕 세상\n' prints '1 2 6' (characters, not bytes) and exits 0
A file containing only '\n' prints '1 0 1' and exits 0

requirements.title: Empty file
requirements.description: An empty file prints '0 0 0' and exits 0.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: An empty file prints '0 0 0' and exits 0

requirements.title: Missing file
requirements.description: If the path does not exist, nothing is written to stdout, stderr gets 'error: file not found: <path>', and the exit code is 2.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A nonexistent path gives empty stdout, stderr 'error: file not found: <path>' and exit code 2

requirements.title: Standard library only, single component
requirements.description: Implemented with the Python standard library only, as one component in the textcli package.

conflict_analysis.method: pairwise review of all four requirements

assumptions.description: Files are read as raw UTF-8 bytes decoded without newline translation, so CRLF counts as 2 characters and 1 line.
assumptions.impact: chars follow the file content exactly

assumptions.description: Invalid UTF-8, directories and unreadable files are unspecified; they are out of scope and not handled specially.
assumptions.impact: no defined behaviour for those inputs

assumptions.description: Only the 'count' subcommand with exactly one path argument is specified; other usage errors fall to argparse defaults.
assumptions.impact: argparse exit code 2 for usage errors
